items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses drumming styles generally and then responds to a question about Buddy Gilmore. Bid Sid is mentioned only by the interviewer as a key figure to discuss, but the interviewee does not provide any personal anecdote, memory, or statement of interaction regarding Bid Sid in the p

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean drumming. Some of them drummers, call themselves drummers, stay on the cymbal all the time, but he'd do a lot of stuff on the snare drum.
Let's key in on Bid Sid and some of these others. I asked you about Buddy Gilmore at one time, the great drummer who was with James Reese Europe. Did you meet him?
Yeah. When I met him, he was living on Long Island.
